entities.summary: The Amsterdam–Arnhem railway, also referred to as the Amsterdam–Elten railway or Rhijnspoorweg in Dutch, is an important railway that connects Amsterdam in the Netherlands with Utrecht and Arnhem, and continues into Germany.
